dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Panthers Hold NFC South Lead Following Thrilling 35-33 Win Over Ravens
dailyTopNewsBrief.summary: Carolina (5-5) holds a two-game lead in the NFC South following a 35-33 victory over Baltimore, despite ranking 31st defensively in red-zone TD rate allowed (76.9%) and 32nd in penalty yards per game (87.4).
bullets: Head coach Dave Canales challenged Carolina to operate with a lead, and the team responded by extending its division edge, as detailed by [panthers.com Official](https://www.panthers.com/news/dave-canales-challenged-his-team-to-learn-how-to-operate-with-a-lead-and-they-answered-nfc-south).

Quarterback Bryce Young directed a clutch game-winning drive while running back Chuba Hubbard delivered his second straight multi-touchdown performance, per [panthers.com Official](https://www.panthers.com/news/chuba-hubbard-does-it-again-and-gets-a-little-help-trevor-etienne).

Linebacker Tyrel Dodson secured the game-winning interception off a wild crunch-time ricochet to halt Baltimore's final comeback attempt, as captured by [panthers.com Video](https://www.panthers.com/video/can-t-miss-play-game-winning-int-tyrel-dodson-secures-brissett-s-pass-in-crunch-time-after-wild-ricochet).

Defensive coordinator Todd Wash's unit generated key situational turnovers, including cornerback Will Lee III forcing a fumble on Derrick Henry, according to [panthers.com Video](https://www.panthers.com/video/will-lee-iii-forces-king-henry-to-fumble-on-close-call).
